     - Append the first component as an integer to list C.
     - Append the components from the second to the second-to-last as a list of integers to list A.
     - Append the last component as a string to list R.
  4. Initialize ans to 0.
  5. Iterate over all possible subsets of the set of N keys, represented by integers from 0 to (1<<N) - 1.
  6. For each subset, set a flag flg to True.
  7. For each test i from 0 to M-1:
     - Initialize a counter cnt to 0.
